API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIAdmin & Role ManagementGet Admin Users
Get Admin Users
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/adminUsers

Gets a list of admin users. By default, auditor user information is not included. To learn more, see About Administrators and About Auditors.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
includeAuditorUsers
boolean

Include or exclude auditor user information in the list.

includeAdminUsers
boolean

Include or exclude admin user information in the list.

Default value: true
search
string

The search string used to partially match against an admin/auditor user's Login ID or Name.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100, but the maximum size is 1000.

Default value: 100
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

Admin or auditor's user ID

loginName
string
REQUIRED

Admin or auditor's login name. The login name is in email format and uses the domain name associated with the Zscaler account.

userName
string
REQUIRED

Admin or auditor's username

email
string
REQUIRED

Admin or auditor's email address

role
object
comments
string

Additional information about the admin or auditor

adminScope
object
isNonEditable
boolean

Indicates whether or not the admin can be edited or deleted

Default value: false
disabled
boolean

Indicates whether or not the admin account is disabled

isAuditor
boolean

Indicates whether the user is an auditor. This attribute is subject to change.

Default value: false
password
string

The admin's password. If the single sign-on (SSO) for the admin is disabled, then this field is mandatory for POST requests. This information is not provided in a GET response.

isPasswordLoginAllowed
boolean

The default value is true when SAML Authentication is disabled. When SAML Authentication is enabled, this can be set to false to force the admin to log in via SSO only.

Default value: false
isSecurityReportCommEnabled
boolean

Enables or disables communication regarding security updates. Enable this to receive the latest information on vulnerabilities and threats that might affect your organization.

Default value: false
isServiceUpdateCommEnabled
boolean

Enables or disables communication regarding service updates. Enable this to receive new Zscaler service and product enhancements, including new data center notification and cloud release information.

Default value: false
isProductUpdateCommEnabled
boolean

Enables or disables communication regarding product updates. Enable if you want the admin to receive communication regarding important changes and updates for the Zscaler service.

Default value: false
isPasswordExpired
boolean

Indicates whether or not an admin's password has expired

Default value: false
isExecMobileAppEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether or not the Executive Insights App access is enabled for the admin

Default value: false
execMobileAppTokens
object[]
newLocationCreateAllowed
boolean

Determines if the user is allowed to create a new location
